{{short description|French mathematician}}
[[File:Gauduchon.jpg|thumb|Paul Gauduchon, Bures-sur-Yvette 2007]]
'''Paul Gauduchon''' (born March 22, 1945) is a French mathematician, known for his work in the field of [[differential geometry]]. He is particularly known for his introduction of ''Gauduchon metrics'' in [[hermitian manifold|hermitian geometry]].<ref>''Editorial [Conformal and complex geometry in honour of Paul Gauduchon].'' Special issue edited by Andrei Moroianu and Liviu Ornea. J. Geom. Phys. 91 (2015), 1.</ref> His textbook on [[spectral geometry]], written with [[Marcel Berger]] and Edmond Mazet, is a standard reference in the field.

from 1965, Gauduchon studied at the [[École polytechnique]] and carried out research for the [[Centre national de la recherche scientifique|CNRS]] from 1968. In 1975, he received his doctorate (Doctor d'Etat) with [[André Lichnerowicz]] at the [[Paris Diderot University|University of Paris VII]] ({{lang|fr|Sur quelques proprietes des fibers holomorphes|italic=yes}}) and completed his habilitation in 1986.<ref>[https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=64282 Mathematics Genealogy Project.]</ref> Since 1990 he has been research director of the CNRS at the Center de Mathématiques of the École Polytechnique in Palaiseau Paris. There he heads the geometry group and organizes the [[Arthur Besse]] seminar on [[Riemannian geometry]]. He also teaches at the Institut des Mathematiques de Jussieu.

== Notable publications ==
*Marcel Berger, Paul Gauduchon, and Edmond Mazet. ''Le spectre d'une variété riemannienne.'' Lecture Notes in Mathematics, Vol. 194 Springer-Verlag, Berlin-New York 1971 vii+251 pp. {{doi|10.1007/BFb0064643}} {{closed access}}
* Paul Gauduchon. [http://www.digizeitschriften.de/dms/resolveppn/?PID{{=}}PPN235181684_0267|log75 ''La 1-forme de torsion d'une variété hermitienne compacte.''] {{free access}} Math. Ann. 267 (1984), no. 4, 495–518. {{doi|10.1007/BF01455968}} {{closed access}}
*Paul Gauduchon. [http://verbit.ru/MATH/Gauduchon_Hermitian_Operators01.pdf ''Hermitian connections and Dirac operators.''] Boll. Un. Mat. Ital. B (7) 11 (1997), no. 2, suppl., 257–288.
